scope: Replace only the reliability-test observer pool with a dedicated pg.Client, register cleanup before connect, and await connect/end. No product transaction, shared fixture, migration, API, main or demonstration changes.
evidence_boundary: The prior intermittent failure had no event timeline. Thirty natural observation runs below passed. A controlled 30ms observer shutdown delay reproduced the same test and error class through a confirmed observer/DROP cleanup race. This is not a direct capture of the earlier intermittent failure scene and does not exclude other possible causes.

source_mechanism.original_fixture: core-reliability.test.ts resources used a raw pg.Pool without a pool error handler and awaited only pool.end before temporaryDatabase issued DROP DATABASE WITH(FORCE).
source_mechanism.installed_pg_pool: pg-pool/index.js _pulseQueue lines 133-142 resolves end once _clients is empty; _remove line 179 removes a client from that array before the asynchronous client.end callback at line 181 completes.
source_mechanism.transaction_path: The transaction receives its intended connection error, sets connectionFailed before aborting the HTTP request, releases the failed client with true, and the following transaction succeeds. No observed rollback/reuse failure was found in the traced reproduction.
source_mechanism.cleanup_race: pool.end can resolve before the observer socket closes. DROP FORCE can then terminate the observer; its raw pool re-emits error without a handler, causing an uncaught exception during cleanup.
source_mechanism.fix: Dedicated pg.Client.end waits for actual connection end. No error listener was added to swallow errors.

runtime.temporary_link: The worktree used a node_modules symlink to the dependency path only during tests; it was removed afterward.
runtime.isolation: Every test used a UUID kapibala_test database. No demonstration or qa-acceptance database was accessed.

natural_observation.observation: Passing traces still show pool.end resolution and DROP issued before the observer client end. The gap alone does not imply failure on every run.

controlled_delay.method: Delay only the observer connection.end call in the preloader, retaining real PostgreSQL connections, test bodies, error emissions and exception behavior. Log via emit wrappers and uncaughtExceptionMonitor; do not consume error events.
controlled_delay.command_pattern: PG_SHUTDOWN_TRACE=<absolute-jsonl-path> PG_SHUTDOWN_DELAY_MS=30 DATABASE_URL=postgres://qa:qa-local@127.0.0.1:50033/postgres node --import /tmp/kapibala-runtime-boundaries-evidence/trace-pg-shutdown.mjs --import tsx --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='transaction client loss during HTTP' tests/integration/core-reliability.test.ts > <absolute-tap-path> 2>&1

regression.command: DATABASE_URL=postgres://qa:qa-local@127.0.0.1:50033/postgres node --import tsx --test tests/integration/core-reliability.test.ts tests/integration/agent-capacity.test.ts tests/integration/lock-admission.test.ts tests/integration/database.test.ts tests/integration/member-rejoin.test.ts
regression.remaining_logs: Some business Database pools still logged handled idle_connection_error near temporary database cleanup. This fixture change does not claim to eliminate all pool shutdown log noise.

delivery: Clean independent branch; main and demonstration unchanged. Dedicated PostgreSQL window released to coordinator; container retained.
